title: wolfHSM C_GenerateKeyPair: generate key on server
description:
Add a wolfHSM path to C_GenerateKeyPair so callers can generate RSA and EC keys on the server without key material ever leaving it.

What needs to be done:
- In C_GenerateKeyPair, add an elif branch for WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM (after the PIV block and before the soft-token fallback)
- For CKM_EC_KEY_PAIR_GEN: call wh_Client_EccMakeExportKey (or equivalent) with the curve OID from the template; server generates the key and returns a whKeyId
- For CKM_RSA_PKCS_KEY_PAIR_GEN: call the RSA keygen equivalent with modulus size from CKA_MODULUS_BITS; server returns a whKeyId
- Allocate wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t structs for the public and private key objects; both share the same key_id
- Create g_keys[] entries for both public and private handles
- Public key: retrieve the public components (modulus+exponent for RSA; uncompressed point for EC) for CKA_MODULUS / CKA_EC_POINT attribute reads

Acceptance criteria:
- pkcs11-tool --module  --generate-keypair --mechanism EC:prime256v1 --slot N succeeds
- The generated private key never leaves the server (private key attributes not extractable)
- C_DestroyObject on either handle frees only the g_keys[] entry; does not delete the server key (server keys are persistent)
